correctness.rationale: The published total mutual visibility iff no selected pair is at Hamming distance two (Bujtás–Klavžar–Tian Theorem 6). Partition by third-coordinate layers: inside one layer selections lie in a binary row or vertical pair; at >=2 active layers vertical pairs vanish, same binary row must share a singleton y coordinate, opposite binary rows have disjoint y supports. Five disjoint occupancy regimes (one active layer; one binary group on >=2 layers; two singleton layers; one singleton and one multi-layer binary group; two multi-layer groups) produce the claimed U_b,Q_n,R_n polynomial. For b,n>=3 only singleton-vs-multilayer type attains b+n-2, with leading coefficient 2bn. Independent complete distance-two conflict-graph enumeration for (b,n)=(3,3) gave polynomial 1+18z+81z^2+84z^3+18z^4, matching the formula. The all-parameter proof is combinatorial, not finite extrapolation.
